risks.title: Dependence on weather and agricultural conditions
risks.score_rationale: Risk is central in 10-K, mentioned first and repeated multiple times. Language is strong: 'materially adversely affected', 'outside of our control'. It directly impacts demand, production, and logistics. 'Industrial' category heavily weighted here. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Sulfur supply disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Cited as potentially having 'material adverse effect', linked to sulfur availability from refineries. Text cites past impacts and structural vulnerability. Alarmist language: 'decreased availability', 'increase costs'. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Tariff tensions with Canada
risks.score_rationale: 25% tariff is recent (2025), with risk of reintroduction. Mention of material effects on operations, demand, and risk of retaliation. Strong language: 'materially adversely affect'. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Vulnerability to energy costs and raw material prices
risks.score_rationale: Natural gas, ammonia, and sulfur are critical. Text emphasizes price volatility and inability to pass on costs. Geopolitical context (Ukraine war) amplifies risk. 'Capital' category moderately weighted. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Risks related to countervailing duties on phosphate
risks.score_rationale: DOC and ITC imposed duties on Moroccan and Russian phosphate. Litigation ongoing. Reversal could harm competition. Central position in text, strong legal language. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Cyber and operational disruption risks
risks.score_rationale: Listed among major disruption causes: 'material disruption', including cyberattacks. Explicit mention in context of high operational intensity. 'Cybersecurity' category moderately weighted. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Political instability in operating countries
risks.score_rationale: Risks cited in Peru (Miski Mayo), with threats of social protests. Possible impact on phosphate supply. Preventive but concerned language: 'potential for active protests'. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Geographic concentration of production assets
risks.score_rationale: Company depends on few key sites in Florida, Louisiana, and Saskatchewan. Multiple mentions of past damage (hurricanes). High disruption risk. Language repeated and concrete. (default score, subject to refinement)
